title: A passed detached full gate carried for an Engram holder got neither a host credit record nor a refusal (test-dfb40cc6, 65+ minutes after it finished)
outcome: Every carried full gate ends in exactly one host outcome visible to its holder (a credit record or a named refusal) by the holder's next checkpoint after the run finishes, and a silent case is diagnosable.
acceptance: The test-4e211496 occurrence is classified from existing records and source: registration and owner versus notification recipient are distinguished, the missing recognition/refusal path is identified, and limits on historical test-dfb40cc6 evidence are recorded.

Foreground focused commands with the actual supported outer launcher options before -- preserve the inner argv and intended Test/Build classification; unknown or malformed outer options yield a named refusal. Existing non-test, watch, shell and detached-focused exclusions remain. Deterministic tests cover Node and the other affected recognizers.

A regression through the existing command-start/end, validated launcher-result and checkpoint owners shows a supported outer-option Node run produces exactly one test observation and verification input while retaining its actual owner independently of notify. Existing source/grant/identity guards remain; registration or PASS alone never mints credit.
